fields.issue: No measured core at or below 10 kg/m3 meets the wrinkling need with 6061 faces on the P2 float ceiling.
fields.numbers: Best measured: meza2014-hollow-alumina-octet-lightest-E at 5.5 kg/m3, Ec*Gc margin 0.000171 on the least-factor split (gap 5.84e+03, 18 on stress; 1.66e+03 at the classical 0.76), gap 1.7e+04 on the buckling split. Band 1-4 kg/m3: kashani2019-npg-3-tension, gap 7.57e+04 (2.16e+04 classical).
fields.closes_when: a measured core's Ec*Gc at its own density meets the need on its row; or a face change lowers the need, which scales as sigma_face^3/E_face (008b's face table); or a wrinkling test on a representative sandwich replaces the CR-1457 design coefficient.
